Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential. Position Overview We are seeking an Advanced Application Support Engineer to join our Global Teamcenter Application Support organization. This role is ideal for someone who already has a solid foundation in technical or application support and is ready to take the next step in their career. You will receive onboarding, product training, and continuous support from experienced engineers while developing deeper expertise in Siemens Teamcenter PLM Product and its supporting technologies. As an Advanced Support Engineer, we are looking for someone who can learn quickly, take initiative, and progress toward working independently faster than an entry-level engineer. You will troubleshoot enterprise applications, infrastructure, configuration, integration, and performance-related issues across Linux and Windows environments. You will work directly with customers while collaborating with experienced Support Engineers, Product Development, Cloud/IT teams, and other specialists across our Global organization. Over time, you will be expected to independently manage increasingly complex customer cases, recognize when additional expertise is needed, and actively drive investigations toward resolution. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support for Siemens Teamcenter and its supporting technologies. Investigate application, configuration, integration, infrastructure, and performance-related customer issues. Analyze application logs, configuration files, diagnostic data, error messages, thread dumps, and other technical information to identify possible causes and next troubleshooting steps. Troubleshoot issues across Linux and Windows environments, including application services, file systems, permissions, processes, connectivity, and resource utilization. Reproduce customer-reported issues in internal environments and develop clear test scenarios. Manage assigned customer cases and maintain ownership of investigation and communication through resolution. Prioritize multiple cases based on severity, customer impact, and business urgency. (Knowledge of SLA’s) Participate in technical escalations and collaborate with senior Support Engineers, SME’s, Cloud Operations, IT, and other specialists when deeper expertise is required. Recognize when an issue may originate outside the application layer and collect the appropriate technical evidence before engaging other teams. Communicate investigation progress, technical findings, solutions, and next steps clearly to customers and internal stakeholders. Document troubleshooting steps, root-cause findings, solutions, and workarounds. Contribute to Knowledge Base articles and other reusable technical documentation. Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve troubleshooting processes, documentation, and customer experience. Continuously develop technical knowledge of Teamcenter and its underlying technology stack. Required Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. 3-5 years of hands-on experience in technical support, application support, systems engineering, or a similar technical role. Experience troubleshooting enterprise or server-based software applications. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to technical problem solving. Working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, including command-line tools, services, processes, permissions, and file systems. Understanding fundamental networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, proxies, firewalls, ports, certificates, and client/server communication. Experience reviewing and analyzing application or system logs. Ability to manage multiple technical issues and organize work according to priority and customer impact. Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly and apply new knowledge to customer problems. Initiative and the ability to work increasingly independently following the initial training and onboarding period. Good judgment in recognizing when additional technical expertise or escalation is required. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Professional proficiency in English is required, as English is the primary working language across our global Support and Engineering organization. Ability to explain technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to collaborate effectively within a geographically distributed global team. Preferred Qualifications Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable: Java or Java-based enterprise applications, particularly application troubleshooting. Apache HTTP Server and web application architectures. Subversion (SVN) administration or troubleshooting. Relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL. AWS or other cloud infrastructure and services. Enterprise authentication technologies such as SAML, OAuth/OIDC, LDAP, Active Directory, or SSO. REST APIs and integration troubleshooting. SQL and basic database troubleshooting. JVM configuration, heap/thread dump analysis, or Java application performance troubleshooting. Strong problem-solving skills are essential, including the ability to investigate complex issues, ask the right questions, research unfamiliar technologies, collaborate effectively with technical experts, and determine appropriate next steps toward resolution. As part of a global organization, there may occasionally be opportunities to adjust your schedule slightly to collaborate with colleagues or attend meetings across different time zones. Our collaborative environment provides opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues, exchange knowledge, and work together on complex technical challenges. You own our managed SOC service and the technical implementation of security tooling, including EDR, SIEM, email filtering, and related defensive platforms; You lead the full incident response lifecycle detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and evidence handling; You define, continuously improve, and maintain operational processes, procedures, playbooks, and workflows for alerting, escalation, and incident handling; You maintain and develop an effective set of detection use cases, providing Fugro with early warning of security events of interest; You drive the continuous hardening of Fugro's IT, cloud, and OT landscape, working with infrastructure, platform, and application teams to ensure baselines, configurations, and security controls remain effective against evolving threats; You own global vulnerability management across infrastructure, applications, cloud, and workplace, setting clear priorities based on risk, exploitability, and business impact, and ensuring remediation is tracked through to closure; You manage Fugro's security testing program, including penetration testing, code scanning, secure development support, and red and purple team exercises, translating findings into structural improvements; You provide management with clear visibility into emerging threats, operational risks, exposure levels, SOC performance, and the overall security posture of the environment; You work closely with Information Security Officers and regional teams across the organization, making sure Security Operations stays aligned with both global standards and business needs; You develop, mentor, and coach team members to ensure they have the support, skills, and capabilities needed to perform effectively; You build and promote an operational culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
